Nina (AE): Prospect requirement summary: BYOK via customer AWS CloudHSM (FIPS 140-2 L3), no key material leaving customer account unless contractually agreed. They want a short POC checklist, a procurement-friendly cost breakdown, and templated answers for their security questionnaire.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a compact POC script focused on three checks: basic encrypt/decrypt, controlled key rotation, and a deliberate grant revoke to exercise fallback behavior. Keep it short for their infra team to run.
Priya (Security): Must include: CloudTrail forwarding to their logging account, KMS key policy with explicit Deny for ScheduleKeyDeletion and DisableKey except via an approved change ticket, and Conditions for aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp where feasible. Also document monitoring/alerts for repeated kms:Decrypt failures.
Luis (SRE): Network/ops checklist for Private deployment: VPC peering or Transit Gateway info, CIDR blocks, an assumable IAM role ARN for redwood-service OR a KMS grant token, and an ops maintenance window for rotation testing. If they insist no key copies leave their account, we must run Redwood Private in their VPC or support on-prem HSM.
Nina (AE): Procurement wants a line-item list they can drop into an RFQ. Do we have a standard stub?
Luis (SRE): Example procurement stub (placeholders to be finalized in SOW):
- Customer AWS CloudHSM: billed by AWS to customer's account; no Redwood markup.
- Integration SOW (network configuration, key ceremony validation, IAM/grant setup): one-time fee $Z (placeholder).
- Private control plane hosting & ops (monitoring, patching, HSM liaison): recurring $W/month.
Note: Hosted offering (Redwood-managed keys) does not include HSM pass-through charges.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Short POC checklist to hand to their infra (one page):
1) Provision an HSM-backed CMK in their AWS account and tag it redwood-poc.
2) Add Key Policy entry OR create a KMS Grant for the Redwood role with Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions.
3) Share CMK ARN and assumable role details (or grant token) with Redwood.
4) Run encrypt/decrypt calls via Redwood API; capture p95/p99 KMS latency.
5) Execute rotation test (alias swap OR create new key + rewrap depending on chosen flow) and confirm decryption of prior objects.
6) Revoke the grant to simulate failure and validate demo fallback (labeled non-HSM demo key; not for production).
Priya (Security): Sample key policy snippet to give their infra (replace account/role ARNs):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"*"},"Action":["kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","kms:DisableKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Priya (Security): Add requirement: CloudTrail KMS events shipped to their logging account with 90-day retention by default; escalate to legal if they ask us to store key material or accept escrow.
Nina (AE): Timeline question: they want a kickoff in ~3 weeks. Can we commit to a POC demo by then?
Luis (SRE): If they provide IAM role/grant, peering/VPN details, and a security contact promptly: we can have the POC demo ready in ~7-10 business days. Full Private+CloudHSM integration (network, key ceremony, validation) typically 4-6 weeks. On-prem HSM adds procurement and vendor lead time.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Procurement FAQ item to include in pack: "Will Redwood ever hold or escrow my CMK material?" Short answer: No for standard BYOK CloudHSM flows. Escrow or custody of key material only if specifically requested and covered by SOW with approved ceremony controls.
Nina (AE): Legal/procurement expects a DPA/appendix for any escrow or custody language; I'll loop Legal if the customer tries to contract escrow.
procurement-bot: Created ticket RFQ-21021 for "CloudHSM BYOK procurement stub & POC pack".
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble the one-page POC script, a short SOW stub with placeholder numbers, and the templated questionnaire answers. Posting ETA EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare the security questionnaire responses and highlight items that must go to Legal.
Nina (AE): Great. I'll collect everything and schedule the kickoff. Please drop any test payloads or IAM snippets into this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
